template_source: existing TandemX read-derived discovery catalogue; supplied prior and not independent of all source reads
array_trimming: reuse frozen 1024-bp natural-flank rule and eligible source records from span_score
decomposition: call unmodified benchmarks.m2_routes.alignment.prototype.decompose with default settings on every eligible original read array and each directly trimmed edited assembly array
technical_decision: ABSTAIN if fewer than three eligible records, any eligible original read path unresolved, native read paths mixed, or edited assembly path unresolved; otherwise DISCORDANT iff label and orientation paths differ, else SUPPORTED
